explain_en: 계획 is something you decide yourself; 약속 is an arrangement with another person. They take different verbs: 계획을 세우다, 약속을 하다.

dis.h: general plan with steps or a schedule

p.n: 약속 means you have an appointment to meet someone.

explain: 받침이 있으면 ‘-을 거예요’(먹을 거예요), 없으면 ‘-ㄹ 거예요’(갈 거예요)를 써요. 소리는 [갈 꺼예요]처럼 나지만 쓸 때는 ‘거예요’예요. 내가 정할 수 없는 일에 쓰면 ‘비가 올 거예요’처럼 추측이 돼요.

explain_en: Use ‘-을 거예요’ after a final consonant (먹을 거예요) and ‘-ㄹ 거예요’ after a vowel (갈 거예요). It sounds like [꺼예요] but is spelled ‘거예요’. For things outside your control, like ‘비가 올 거예요’, it becomes a guess (It'll probably rain).
